Pemrose boardroom canapés.d: Warm buckwheat pancakes, crème fraîche, dill and cracked pepper. By the dozen.
Pemrose boardroom canapés.note: Boardroom trays, order a day ahead.

Kansas corn fritters.d: Kernels and scallions in a light egg batter, fried by the spoonful. Sour cream to dip.
Kansas corn fritters.note: A taste of home, straight off the farm.

Mailroom sandwich bites.d: Ham, cheddar and pickle on buttered white bread, crusts off, in wax paper.
Mailroom sandwich bites.note: Comes down on the mail cart at 11.

Executive rib eye.d: Seared in a hot iron pan, basted with butter, garlic and thyme, sliced.

Kansas farm fried chicken.d: Soaked overnight, floured and fried crisp. Mashed potatoes, pan gravy.

Kansas apple pie.d: Double crust, cinnamon apples, sugared top, vanilla ice cream.
Kansas apple pie.note: To finish, with coffee by the pot.

Martini.d: Stirred with dry vermouth, up in a frozen glass, lemon twist.
Martini.note: Bar from 5:30 PM for those working late.
